title: Data Boundary Ambiguity in Approval Thresholds
description: Tests discovery of data boundary ambiguities where numerical boundaries lack explicit inclusive or exclusive interval specifications.

expectedRequirements.statementPattern: .*Standard customer orders are captured by the order processing gateway.*
.*Freight shipments with valuation up to and including \$25,000 qualify for expedited routing.*

expectedFindings.rationale: Purchase order approval threshold is boundary-ambiguous: one clause requires dual sign-off for orders of '$10,000 or more' while another clause cites orders 'exceeding $10,000', without defining whether an order of exactly $10,000 requires single or dual sign-off.

expectedNonFindings.description: Expedited freight threshold explicitly resolves interval boundary by specifying up to and including $25,000 and confirming exactly $25,000 is inclusive, and must not be flagged as boundary ambiguous.
